protocol: specialist-compact-v3; S1-mini prescribed contract, CPU quality validation extension
reviewer: Assistant manually read all10 actual integration inputs/candidates/final texts. Known development diagnostics; not fresh heldout. No inference or tuning by reviewer.
scope: POST-HOLDOUT VALIDATION EXTENSION for added candidate. Actual Core/dictionary/cleanup orchestration with counted insertion; no raw model response or GPU measurement. Text-fixture probe through the real DictationEngine, dictionary, number normalizer, optional cleanup provider and delivery orchestration. A generated tone and canned transcriber feed the selected transcript; RecordingTextInjector counts calls without typing. This does not test recognition accuracy, a microphone, a physical hotkey, foreground application insertion, Windows worker ownership or whole-desktop performance. Candidate text precedes Core validation; output is the accepted result or original-text fallback. Automatic checks do not establish semantic fidelity.

definitions.faithful: Alias of final_faithful. Candidate fidelity remains null when provider returns none. Original fallback can retain meaning without achieving cleanup.
definitions.useful: Accepted faithful candidate improves a cleanup defect; failed provider/fallback gives no model edit credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Complete faithful cleanup with clean presentation; inserted comma after protected trailing spaces fails this criterion.
definitions.raw_cause: No native response in Core report; do not infer exact generation or parser cause solely from Processor:InvalidDataException.
